goal.text: The wearer is walking one lap of the home with a guest and wants a running log of which spaces she has covered and what she has left unfinished.

turns.text: Okay, I want to do one lap of the place and log what still needs doing before people arrive. Start from now.

trigger.detail: she sets the task up as she walks into the living area

expected_answer.text: Logging now. I'll track each room you walk through and what you touch along the way.

turns.text: Which hand was I using on those pillows?

trigger.detail: gaze leaves the sink area for the lamp while she is pushing cushions around

expected_answer.text: Your left. You bent over the sofa and shifted a couple of pillows with it, then straightened up.

turns.text: That thing I opened first — did I go back?

trigger.detail: the screen drops out of view as she turns away

expected_answer.text: Not while I was watching. You opened it with both hands on the way in and never came back to it.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm — so that's the first room ticked off, then?

trigger.detail: she stands and looks around before leaving the living area

expected_answer.text: That's one. You've finished in the living area and you're turning toward the hallway now.

turns.text: Next one — in, or just a look?

trigger.detail: she halts and looks into the restroom from the hallway

expected_answer.text: Just looked. You stopped at the doorway, glanced in, then turned right and carried on down the corridor.

turns.text: oh, before I forget, how many spaces?

trigger.detail: a third of the lap is done and nothing has been counted yet

expected_answer.text: Three. The living area, the hallway, and the washroom you only looked into just now.

turns.text: — what are my hands doing walking in?

trigger.detail: she crosses into the bedroom mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Folded in front of your chest. You've held them like that since you stopped in the doorway.

turns.text: um, hang on — what did I just bend down to?

trigger.detail: she lowers both arms and bends toward the drawer

expected_answer.text: A drawer. You lowered both arms, bent over, and put both hands flat on it.

turns.text: Right, before that I was at the bed — what exactly did I sort out on it?

trigger.detail: she finishes squaring up the bedding and turns to her peer

expected_answer.text: Two things. You shifted the pillow across, then squared off the blanket, both hands, before you turned round.

turns.text: I'm up on my toes at something.

trigger.detail: she comes up out of the crouch and stands looking into the closet

expected_answer.text: At the upper part of the closet. You're on tiptoe trying to see over what's at eye level.

turns.text: — so what was I doing down at floor level before that?

trigger.detail: she is still at the open closet and the earlier crouch has gone unlogged

expected_answer.text: Crouched at the same cupboard, with your right hand on something inside it, before you stood back up.

turns.text: How many times shut and open again?

trigger.detail: she has just re-opened the closet she shut a few seconds earlier

expected_answer.text: Once each. You pushed it shut with both hands, stepped back, then came straight forward and opened it again.

turns.text: uh, wait — am I actually moving things up there, or just looking?

trigger.detail: she goes up on her toes toward the shelves mid-answer

expected_answer.text: Moving them. You're back on tiptoe with your right hand, sliding a few items along the shelf.

turns.text: Last thing in there — what did I have hold of?

trigger.detail: the closet and the bedroom leave view as she steps into the hallway

expected_answer.text: The door. You had both hands on it as you stepped away, then you were out in the corridor.

turns.text: sorry, quick one — this spot I've stopped at, have I stood here before?

trigger.detail: she pauses in the hallway with both hands on her waist

expected_answer.text: You have. You were in this exact spot about seventy seconds ago, looking into the washroom then too.

turns.text: How did I get from the bedroom here?

trigger.detail: she is stretched up holding something on top of the refrigerator

expected_answer.text: Out along the corridor, through the living area, then right into the dining space where you are now.

turns.text: no, I mean — which way did I turn when I came through?

trigger.detail: she narrows her own question while still reaching overhead

expected_answer.text: To the right. You came in from the living area, turned right, and stopped by the others.

turns.text: Leaning over just then — touching what?

trigger.detail: she leans left and touches something resting on a chair as she passes

expected_answer.text: Something resting on a chair. You brushed it with your left hand twice as you went past it.

turns.text: — I'm pointing at something now, aren't I?

trigger.detail: she raises an arm toward the wall mid-answer

expected_answer.text: At the pictures on the wall in front of you, with your left hand up, talking them through.

turns.text: speaking of which, give me the rooms in order?

trigger.detail: she asks for the tally the lap was being logged for

expected_answer.text: Living area, hallway, bedroom and its closet, back down the hallway, the dining area, and now this one.

turns.text: — so what's left on the list?

trigger.detail: she closes the lap out before moving on

expected_answer.text: Only the thing you opened on your way in at the start. Everything else you touched, you finished.
